## Où j'en suis
Real SAML login works on staging with Fernhill's IdP: the short RelayState fix cleared their ADFS error, JIT provisioning is merged in #415, and the group-to-role mapping (f4a91c7) sits in PR #421, open. No coding work is left to start; everything now waits on Fernhill IT adding the groups claim ahead of Thursday's demo (source: ses-sso-3, src-pr415, src-linear-kes311)

- [en-cours] PR #421 "SAML: group to role mapping + short RelayState" open, not merged (source: ses-sso-3)
- [prochaine-étape] Fernhill IT adds the groups claim (Daniel emails them), then create an admin test account next to `kestrel.test1` (source: ses-sso-3, s3-08)
- [prochaine-étape] demo with Fernhill IT Thursday Nov 19, 10:00 ET (source: src-linear-kes311, s3-10)
- [essai-raté] full return URL as RelayState (143 bytes) failed with MSIS7042 at their ADFS; replaced by a short opaque id in Redis, TTL 600 s (source: s3-02, s3-03, s3-04)
- [décision] default role stays `viewer` and SP-initiated login stays on, despite Fernhill IT asking for analyst / IdP-initiated only, until Maya talks to them (source: s3-07, s3-05)
- [décision] SAML only for Fernhill, no OIDC (source: s1-03)
